selector.rationale: New deep itching and creeping sensations in bilateral shoulders and arms, worse at rest, partially relieved by movement, and predominantly occurring in the evening, are consistent with akathisia, especially given the recent changes in psychiatric medications.

rejected.label: Serotonin Syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of mentioned symptoms such as fever, sweating, or autonomic instability

rejected.label: Restless Legs Syndrome
rejected.why: Symptoms are not limited to the legs and do not fit the typical presentation of Restless Legs Syndrome
